extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and contributors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for locating an existing Wikipedia page or creating a new article (including account requirements, searching for alternatives, redirects, and deletion checks). Intended to help users resolve a 'page does not exist' result.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Late show history book' in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the search box to look for alternative titles or spellings before creating a new page. This helps avoid duplication and finds existing coverage under a different name.

rubrics_metrics.name: You need to be logged in and autoconfirmed to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you do not have an account or are not autoconfirmed, you cannot create a new article; register and meet autoconfirmation requirements (as per Wikipedia policy) or use alternative submission pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a full article directly (e.g., due to new user restrictions), use the article wizard to draft for review or use the 'request a new article' process so experienced editors can assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searching for incoming links or mentions can reveal existing coverage or related pages; it also helps determine whether a redirect or merge is more appropriate than creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may be delayed or require purging
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a duplicate, allow time for recent creations to propagate or use the 'purge' tool to refresh the page view. This avoids accidental duplication when the database is updating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try alternative capitalizations (e.g., 'Late Show History Book' vs 'Late show history book') and, if you control the correct title, create a redirect from common variants to the canonical page to assist users.

rubrics_metrics.name: If deleted, check deletion log and deletion help
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log and help pages to understand reasons a page may have been removed (notability, sourcing, copyright, etc.) before attempting to recreate it; follow remediation steps if applicable.
